4550-5567-6798-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-6798-8298--112.description:

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1021-5226-6303-6763.description:

Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.

1957-2324-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Proper Burial ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

776-1458--63.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one creature that does not have summoning sickness.
776-1458--63.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control without summoning sickness.
Jeskai Ascendacy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
If the permanent that costs {0} can tap to add mana, activate it by tapping it, adding at least one mana.
Activate the creature by tapping it, returning the free permanent to your hand.
Cast that permanent by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Arc Reactor.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.

1483-6797-6972--112.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
1483-6797-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2921-3234-3293-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2921-3234-3293-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat
2921-3234-3293-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

193-3573-3604.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
193-3573-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Tolarian Academy.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3573-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

2079-2457-4094-4289.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2079-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-647-2034.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2511-2527-4073-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jan Jansen.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-2499-3389-5478-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.

When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-3433-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Hornet Queen.
1409-3433-4050.description:
Activate Hornet Queen by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator triggers.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Hornet Queen.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Insects, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1167-2047-2719.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Mindslaver.
Activate the token Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1283-2436-2635-3716.notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2436-2635-3716.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying a total of at least {7}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, untapping Marwyn and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing at least two damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

1424-1486-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Presence of Gond attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
1424-1486-4222.description:
Activate Magda by tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Magda's ability, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

457-2558-4139.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sword of the Meek, adding {U}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter creature token with flying and causing you to gain 1 life.
The Thopter enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, causing you to return Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat.
Once you have an infinite amount of Thopter tokens, you may tap them using Urza's first ability to get infinite {U}, and then use the mana to activate Urza's second ability infinite times.
